parsed.rationale: Both participating records reside under `Tests/` subdirectories (`Shared/Playback/Tests/HLSPlayerTests/MockHLSAVPlayer.swift` and `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTestUtilities/Mocks/MockPlayer.swift`) and carry `Mock`-prefixed type names (`MockHLSAVPlayer.play`, `MockPlayer.play`). Although the pipeline emitted `is_mock=false` for both entries, the file paths and naming conventions are unambiguous literal evidence from the cluster row that these are test-double fixtures. Each mock exists to satisfy a distinct protocol stub (`MockHLSAVPlayer` for the HLS-specific player contract, `MockPlayer` for the general player contract), so the coincident `play` method body is an expected artefact of independent stub implementations rather than accidental duplication. Merging or extracting these would couple two separate test-support targets and risk polluting `PlaybackTestUtilities` with HLS-specific concerns.
